title: ATLAS Normalized Event (atlas-event/0.1)
description: One line of the append-only ledger (NDJSON). seq is assigned by the ledger; ordering within a branch is total: (t, type rank, subject, work_id).

branch.description: history:<name> for evidence-derived ledgers; sim:<name> for simulated branches

t.description: unix seconds; the only field the reducer orders on

subject.description: canonical id of the entity the event is primarily about (order, employee, equipment)

source.description: source system id (pos, kds, staffhub, iot, notes, simulation)

record_id.description: stable id of the source record; the receipt key

record_ts.description: timestamp as the source recorded it (event time)

adapter.description: adapter id and version, or engine version for simulated events

derived_from.description: parent record ids for derived/inferred claims

confidence.description: null = unquantified (distinct from 0). Only set when computed, never guessed.

correction_of.description: event_id superseded by a human correction
